title: Voiding of World
description: Voiding of World continues to push the boundaries of Minecraft’s survival genre an ambitious, atmospheric chapter inspired by Souls‑like philosophy
body:
![Voiding Of World](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55de20467e874ec4a5e537afaa44ab6572445934_0.webp)

# **Voiding of World Mod-Pack as Souls-Like**

![Vow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc4fe0a2f44cc448a664271e14886a101b3c48e7.png)
- 
>  As light fades and the realm fractures, step into a world where silence carries weight and every shadow hides intent.
Traverse mist‑drenched valleys, haunted ruins, and sacred forests bathed in violet fog. Each encounter demands precision - every strike, every dodge, every breath.

![bos](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c22199e89072dc104deff4f0ad09e40c11e9dba_0.webp)

> 🎇 Players will be drawn into an experience of luminous decay and quiet tension, where beauty and danger coexist. The landscapes shimmer with ethereal light, yet the air hums with unease. Combat is deliberate and unforgiving, rewarding patience and mastery over haste.

Veterans and wanderers alike will lose themselves in the pack’s hallmark atmosphere - bright yet mournful, serene yet perilous.

Only echoes remain… Prepare yourself once more and embrace the fading light.
